posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a wholesome family photo dump with husband Vicky Kaushal and baby son Vihaan, giving fans a rare glimpse of her life as a new mom.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' released June 12 with its full album out June 15, even as he rolls on with his AURA World Tour.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The 'Alpha' trailer dropped on June 17, unveiling Alia and Sharvari's grand entry into YRF's Spy Universe with a confirmed Hrithik Roshan cameo.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Newly named a Rolex Testimonee, Priyanka is deep into SS Rajamouli's globe-spanning 'Varanasi' alongside her international projects.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is gearing up for 'King', releasing this December alongside daughter Suhana, as he settles into his newly minted billionaire status.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena gave a warm shoutout to sister Karisma as her series 'Brown' began streaming, and was spotted out and about in Bandra.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's next, 'Eetha', has locked an August 28, 2026 release, with its teaser set to be attached to 'Cocktail 2'.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, Deepika is balancing 'King' with SRK and a role in Allu Arjun's big-budget 'Raaka'.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Riding the massive worldwide success of 'Dhurandhar', Ranveer is celebrating the franchise's blockbuster run as it heads to a Japan release.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya turned heads at Cannes 2026 with daughter Aaradhya by her side, marking her 24th year gracing the red carpet at the festival.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Now signing off as 'Rashmika Mandanna Deverakonda' after marrying Vijay Deverakonda, she has wrapped a song shoot for her action thriller 'Mysaa' as 'Cocktail 2' nears release.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's producer debut 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' hits theatres June 19, with strong North America advance sales crossing $125K ahead of release.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's ambitious sci-fi spectacle with Atlee, 'AA22xA6', began filming on June 12, with the star playing a dual role opposite Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' has crossed Rs 317 crore worldwide, becoming his highest-grossing solo film as he lines up RC16 with Buchi Babu Sana.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Bollywood debut 'War 2' opposite Hrithik Roshan arrives August 14, even as buzz builds around his Prashanth Neel actioner 'Dragon'.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is celebrating 'Homebound' as India's official Oscars 2026 entry, while her hit 'Peddi' returns with an extended cut after a portrayal row.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: A heartwarming father-daughter dance with Chunky Panday at an awards show went viral, as Ananya's romance 'Chand Mera Dil' enjoys a steady theatrical run.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara is embracing her 'mom era' with daughter Saraayah, candidly opening up about her postpartum journey ahead of 'War 2' and 'Toxic'.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Recovered from his leg injury, Hrithik is shooting the climactic 'War 2' dance face-off with Jr NTR this June, calling his co-star 'simply amazing'.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai', reuniting him with father David Dhawan, has emerged as one of 2026's biggest romantic hits.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Fresh off releasing her single 'Siddha Bhajo', Shreya kicks off the Australia–New Zealand leg of her global 'Unstoppable Tour' on June 20 in Auckland.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman's chart-topping soundtrack for 'Peddi' is fuelling the film's box office, with 'Chikiri Chikiri' crossing 200 million views online.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: After his TVK party's stunning 2026 Assembly debut, Vijay is pushing to clear his final film 'Jana Nayagan' for a late-June release, even offering to refund distributors himself.
